claims.text: Tejon Ranch is working with LA County to advance Centennial through re-entitlement after the litigation was resolved.

citation.quote: Now that this litigation is resolved, the Company is in the process of working with LA County to advance the Centennial project and is seeking re-entitlement of the Centennial project (“re-entitlement”).

claims.text: The company is circulating an RPDEIR for public review and comment to facilitate re-entitlement consideration before LA County’s Regional Planning Commission and ultimately the Board of Supervisors late this year.

citation.quote: the Company is presently circulating a recirculated partial draft environmental impact report (“RPDEIR”) for public review and comment that is expected to facilitate the consideration of re-entitlement before LA County’s Regional Planning Commission and (ultimately) the Board of Supervisors late this year.
